verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a public REST API for creating integrations and automating workflows, plus a GraphQL API with schema reference docs. The REST API has date-based versioning with advance notice of breaking changes, a stable, generally available OpenAPI description, and fine-grained token permissions that are reported per endpoint. The probe's 404s at docs.github.com OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the OpenAPI description is published in the github/rest-api-description repository. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually driving GitHub through the API.
